protocol.finite_horizon: H-step Bellman target includes gamma^H times same frozen head at actual successor; zero at terminal. This is not an H-step return predictor.
protocol.raw_alignment: observation[t], action[t] chosen there, reward[t] received on arrival; terminal action is Driver-masked and not executed; episode_offsets includes reset and terminal states

protocol.state_weighting: uniform sampled state-agent pairs; episode_initial and alive/dead slices reported separately; agents/states are correlated
protocol.timeout_semantics: unchanged SMAC adapter: all is_last (including timeouts) are is_terminal
protocol.value_target: V(s_t) versus sum of gamma^(k-1)*reward[t+k] through true terminal
